q-rng.title: Behavior preservation, RNG-exact
q-rng.imperative: Identical RNG call order/seeding: fork_rng + manual_seed around init, post-init re-seed with comment, random.Random(seed) shuffle; no RNG call added/removed/reordered.
q-rng.finding: _init_module_and_scheduler (lines 250-260) preserves exact sequence vs main lines 90-101: fork_rng() -> manual_seed(seed) -> resolved_cls(config) init INSIDE fork; then post-fork torch.manual_seed(seed) re-seed with full explanatory comment verbatim; then random.Random(seed); then _build_optimizer. _run_train_epoch shuffles via rng_shuffle.shuffle(shuffled) once per epoch (same as main). No RNG-consuming call added/removed/reordered. test_training_reproducibility (4 tests incl bit-identical-same-seed) green.

q-earlystop.title: Early-stop semantics identical
q-earlystop.imperative: min_delta comparison direction, patience counting, best-checkpoint snapshot timing, restore condition, early_stopped/epochs_run values.
q-earlystop.finding: _eval_and_track_checkpoint (184-233): improved = eval_total < state.best_eval_total - float(config.min_delta) — same direction/operand as main. best_state_dict detach().clone() snapshot taken only on improvement, same timing. epochs_without_improvement reset to 0 on improve else +=1 — identical. best_epoch=epoch+1. Restore condition in orchestrator (434): validation_list and config.restore_best_checkpoint and es_state.best_state_dict is not None — identical to main. early_stopped set True + break when validation_list and epochs_without_improvement >= early_stop_patience (same). epochs_run=epoch+1 set before break. test_early_stop_stops_after_configured_patience and test_best_checkpoint_is_restored green.

q-diagnostics.title: Diagnostics identical
q-diagnostics.imperative: Final diagnostics keys/derivations, epoch_reports row shape incl learning_rate timing, JSONL row content/flush, empty-validation fallback, restored-best override.
q-diagnostics.finding: _build_final_diagnostics (304-363): all 24 top-level keys + derivations byte-match main, incl final_eval_total=epoch_reports[-1]['eval_total'], final_train_loss=epoch_losses[-1], pairwise_metrics=last_loss_payload, dqi_support_summary, known_limitations list. Empty-validation fallback (last_eval_metrics or {...} with _r_over_sigma_uncertainty_diagnostics on empty tensors) identical. restored_best_checkpoint and best_eval_metrics is not None override identical. _write_epoch_diagnostics_row (143-170): same JSONL keys (epoch+1, train_total, supervised_nll/sigma_nll/sym/reg via .get), same _last_pairwise/_last_batch is not None guard before _append_epoch_r_over_sigma_diagnostics, write + flush. eval_supervised_nll=get('supervised_nll', eval_total) identical. learning_rate read at row-build time from optimizer.param_groups[0]['lr'] (orchestrator line 418), same timing as main.

q-edgepaths.title: Edge paths preserved
q-edgepaths.imperative: try/finally handle close on exception; validation_batches None vs empty; epochs_run when early-stopped.
q-edgepaths.finding: try/finally (396-431) preserved: _diagnostics_handle opened before try, closed in finally if not None — survives exception in loop, identical to main. validation_batches None->[] resolved in _validate_training_inputs (line 81: list(...) if not None else []); empty validation_list -> all per-epoch eval skipped (report_fields stays None), best_* stay None, no early stop, restore skipped — identical. epochs_run=epoch+1 assigned before the early-stop break so early-stopped run reports the epoch at which it stopped — identical. test_no_validation_preserves_fixed_epoch_behavior green; full-train integration tests (test_train_race_power_module_*, jsonl, retro_delta) green.

q-no-evo-import.title: No evo import
q-no-evo-import.finding: training.py imports: only stdlib (json, math, random, dataclasses, typing), torch, and relative .config/.models/.modules/.preprocessor_contract. Zero src/evo_predictor import. Grep of src/latent_power for 'evo_predictor' hits only README.md (doc prose), not any .py.

q-no-mutable-module-state.title: No mutable module-level state
q-no-mutable-module-state.imperative: _EarlyStopState instances must be function-local; no module-level mutable runtime state.
q-no-mutable-module-state.finding: _EarlyStopState is a @dataclass (type def at module level, allowed). Its only instantiation es_state = _EarlyStopState() is function-local inside train_latent_power_module (orchestrator line 388). No module-level mutable runtime instance; mutation happens via passed object inside _eval_and_track_checkpoint(state=...). Compliant with 'mutable runtime state belongs in passed objects or function scope'.

q-tests-real.imperative: New tests test helper contracts, are deterministic, py-compatible idioms consistent with file style; not vacuous.
q-tests-real.finding: 15/16 new tests genuinely exercise helper contracts and are deterministic (fixed seeds, monkeypatch fakes), matching existing try/except/else file style. Each helper covered: _validate_training_inputs (5 tests incl resolution + 3 raise paths), _run_train_epoch (2), _write_epoch_diagnostics_row (2 incl None no-op), _EarlyStopState/_eval_and_track_checkpoint (2 incl improve + no-improve counter), _build_epoch_report_row (2), _init_module_and_scheduler (2 incl bit-identical same-seed weights), _build_final_diagnostics (1, 24-key superset).
